name: Timeless Turf — Instant Form leads → Facebook lead router

mapper.data:
{
  "form_name": "instant-{{if(contains(lower(2.name); "membership"); "membership"; if(contains(lower(2.name); "putting"); "putting-green"; "clean"))}}",
  "form_title": "{{2.name}}",
  "created_at": "{{1.dateCreated}}",
  "site_url": "Facebook Instant Form",
  "data": {
    "name": "{{ifempty(get(1.data; "full_name"); first(first(map(1.field_data; "values"; "name"; "full_name"))))}}",
    "phone": "{{ifempty(get(1.data; "phone_number"); first(first(map(1.field_data; "values"; "name"; "phone_number"))))}}",
    "email": "{{ifempty(get(1.data; "email"); first(first(map(1.field_data; "values"; "name"; "email"))))}}",
    "zip": "{{ifempty(get(1.data; "zip_code"); first(first(map(1.field_data; "values"; "name"; "zip_code"))))}}",
    "size": "{{ifempty(get(1.data; "about_how_big_is_the_turf?"); first(first(map(1.field_data; "values"; "name"; "about_how_big_is_the_turf?"))))}}",
    "dogs": "{{ifempty(get(1.data; "do_dogs_use_it?"); first(first(map(1.field_data; "values"; "name"; "do_dogs_use_it?"))))}}",
    "issue": "{{ifempty(get(1.data; "what_bothers_you_most?"); first(first(map(1.field_data; "values"; "name"; "what_bothers_you_most?"))))}}",
    "plan_pick": "{{ifempty(get(1.data; "which_plan_sounds_right?"); first(first(map(1.field_data; "values"; "name"; "which_plan_sounds_right?"))))}}",
    "green_size": "{{ifempty(get(1.data; "how_big_is_the_green?"); first(first(map(1.field_data; "values"; "name"; "how_big_is_the_green?"))))}}",
    "green_issue": "{{ifempty(get(1.data; "what_is_the_green_doing?"); first(first(map(1.field_data; "values"; "name"; "what_is_the_green_doing?"))))}}",
    "green_where": "{{ifempty(get(1.data; "where_is_the_green?"); first(first(map(1.field_data; "values"; "name"; "where_is_the_green?"))))}}",
    "utm_source": "{{1.platform}}",
    "utm_medium": "instant_form",
    "utm_campaign": "{{ifempty(1.campaignName; 1.campaign_name)}}",
    "utm_content": "{{ifempty(1.adName; 1.ad_name)}}",
    "utm_term": "{{ifempty(1.adsetName; 1.adset_name)}}",
    "page": "Instant Form: {{2.name}}",
    "lead_id": "{{1.leadgenId}}"
  }
}
